text: {"answerable":true,"answer":"The error indicates that the IdP signing certificate has rotated. [S1][S2] To resolve it, re‑import the IdP metadata and enable auto‑refresh from the metadata URL. [S1][S2] If auto‑refresh is disabled, the rotation will break every login immediately and you will need to manually re‑import the metadata. [S3] Meridian caches IdP metadata for 24 hours, so with auto‑refresh you should see the new certificate within that window. [S3] According to the error code reference, this is a non‑retryable 401 error caused by the IdP certificate rotation.
